name: Debian Live (testing) Xfce
description: The Debian testing live desktop with Xfce. The kernel and initrd are booted directly; the root filesystem is streamed from the ISO with range requests.
notes: Needs images/debian-live-testing-amd64-xfce/live/{vmlinuz,initrd.img}: run tools/stage-images.sh on the ISO. The initrd (216 MiB) is downloaded before boot.
cmdline: boot=live components console=tty0 console=ttyS0 quiet splash systemd.default_device_timeout_sec=900
